hook: Microbes meet sinking marine snow most at 14.4 m/day, and far less once it sinks faster than 78.1 m/day.

readout.label: Sinking speed at peak microbial encounter rate

summary: Microbes at sea swim toward sinking marine snow only within a limited zone, and fast sinking shrinks that zone. The team tracked single cells around freshly collected aggregates on a ship under imposed flows, then fed the measured encounter rates into a transport model. Encounter rates peak at 14.4 m/day. The measurements come from limited shipboard samples, so the model's reach to the whole ocean is untested.
title: Chemotactic Horizons Regulate Threshold Dynamics in the Biological Carbon Pump
